summary: Array.isArray determines whether a value is an actual array.
documentation: Array.isArray determines whether a value is an actual array. It distinguishes arrays from ordinary objects, null and strings without relying on typeof, which reports arrays as objects.
caution: An object with a length property is not necessarily an array. This check does not validate the types of array elements.
scenarios: Validate that an imported JSON field contains a list.
Choose a list renderer only for actual array data.
Reject malformed batch input before iterating over it.
title: Accept only list-shaped data
problem: Return true when the input is a JSON array, including an empty array. Return false for objects, strings, numbers, Booleans and null.
goal: Use Array.isArray() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
hint: Use Array.isArray rather than typeof or a length-property check.
